report: Lung core biopsy demonstrates malignant gland-forming epithelial cells with mucin production. Tumor cells are strongly positive for TTF-1 and Napsin A and negative for p40.

case_specific_prompts.benign lung tissue: benign lung tissue with open alveolar spaces, delicate septa, bland pneumocytes, and no cytologic atypia
case_specific_prompts.lung adenocarcinoma: lung adenocarcinoma with malignant gland formation, acinar or lepidic growth, atypical columnar cells, and possible mucin
case_specific_prompts.lung squamous cell carcinoma: lung squamous cell carcinoma with atypical squamous nests, keratin pearls, intercellular bridges, and eosinophilic cytoplasm

evidence.title: Various antibody clones of Napsin A, TTF-1, and p40 in non-small cell lung carcinoma
evidence.text: This tissue-microarray study evaluated CK5, p63, and p40 as squamous markers and Napsin A and TTF-1 as lung adenocarcinoma markers. Combining Napsin A with TTF-1 improved sensitivity.

evidence.title: Immunostaining for TTF-1, Napsin A, p40, and cytokeratin 5 aids differential diagnosis of NSCLC
evidence.text: TTF-1 and Napsin A supported adenocarcinoma, while p40 and CK5 supported squamous differentiation; the combined panel was more informative than a single stain.

evidence.title: Value of Napsin A and thyroid transcription factor-1 in primary lung adenocarcinoma
evidence.text: Napsin A and TTF-1 were frequently expressed in primary lung adenocarcinoma. Interpretation as a panel is more informative than an isolated marker.

review.assessment: The case findings support lung adenocarcinoma despite disagreement among the image-only model outputs.
rationale: Malignant gland formation and mucin production favor adenocarcinoma morphology.
TTF-1 and Napsin A positivity with p40 negativity supports lung adenocarcinoma over squamous carcinoma.
QuiltNet and PLIP retained lung adenocarcinoma after case-specific prompting; MUSK and CONCH selected squamous carcinoma.
recommended_review: Confirm gland formation and mucin on the full slide.
Review TTF-1, Napsin A, and p40 controls and staining distribution.
Reconcile the image-model disagreement before final sign-out.

result.prompt_generation_prompt: Extract short, visually discriminative microscopic features for each candidate using the case findings and retrieved lung-pathology evidence.
result.review_prompt: Compare the case findings, retrieved evidence, candidate-specific prompts, and all four saved model outputs; then prepare a concise review brief.
